title: What official reviewers wrote about these rules
question: Has the Controller, the Budget and Legislative Analyst, the Board or the Fire Department questioned a staffing or pay rule?
finding: 14 passages from 9 official documents. The Controller (2004) listed San Francisco, Milwaukee and San Jose as staffing trucks with five and wrote that the remaining jurisdictions used four; the Budget and Legislative Analyst (2014) wrote that Proposition F locked in the 2004 response system. No review on disk calls a fire, police or sheriff staffing rule outdated; the Board's 2015 resolution called the 1,971-officer police minimum outdated in the sense of too low.
how: Passages located by their own wording in the review files on disk and quoted to at most 25 words. The review list was built by searching; it is not every review ever written.
limits: Several reviews are old (2004, 2013, 2014) and the rules or conditions may have changed since. The Budget and Legislative Analyst's 2014 fire audit is on disk; its later audits named in the download notes are not. A reviewer's question about a rule is not a finding that the rule is unnecessary.
